name: Jermaine Tholson
source:
He started learning about weapon crafting with his father when he was young. He is hardworking and knows how to care for others around him. Following his father's passing, he took over his business. Although he still misses him, he and his mother now rely on one another.

Jermaine kept in mind that his father always said he wanted to go to the seaside back home after retiring, so he wants to take his mother back home once he finds a successor for the weapon shop.

[Edited from in-game bio]
